**Orbis Freight Opens Rotterdam Hub**

We are delighted to share that Orbis Freight opened its state-of-the-art Rotterdam hub on 14 October 2025, a milestone that marks an exciting new chapter for our European network. Spanning 38,000 square metres, the facility is home to 220 dedicated staff who bring energy, expertise and commitment to every shipment.

The €46.5 million investment reflects our confidence in the future of sustainable logistics. Thanks to the hub's design, CO2 emissions per parcel are down 18% versus our Antwerp site, showing that growth and responsibility can move forward together.

Our partnerships with Maersk and DB Schenker strengthen our capabilities across the supply chain, giving customers faster, more reliable deliveries. We are targeting 1.2 million parcels per week by Q2 2026.

Under the leadership of CEO Marta Lindqvist, the Rotterdam team is building momentum every day. Their dedication and ingenuity are the driving force behind our growth, and we look forward to what lies ahead. We thank our customers, partners and colleagues for making this launch such a success.

Learn more at https://orbisfreight.example.com/rotterdam
